mapper.sql: assignment.id, assignment.task_id, assignment.source_type, assignment.source_organization_id, source_organization.organization_name AS source_organization_name, task.title, task.difficulty_level, task.base_points, task.duration_minutes, assignment.scheduled_date, assignment.due_at, task.category_code, task.remark, assignment.current_status, assignment.current_reviewer_id, reviewer.display_name AS reviewer_display_name, CASE WHEN assignment.current_status = 'IN_PROGRESS' AND active_pause.id IS NOT NULL THEN 'PAUSED' ELSE assignment.current_status END AS effective_status, assignment.last_defer_type, assignment.overnight_migrated, active_pause.id AS active_pause_id, active_pause.pause_type AS active_pause_type, active_pause.started_at AS pause_started_at, active_pause.expires_at AS pause_expires_at, latest_checkin.id AS latest_checkin_id, latest_checkin.submission_no AS latest_submission_no, latest_checkin.content AS latest_checkin_content, latest_checkin.status AS latest_checkin_status, latest_checkin.submitted_at AS latest_submitted_at, latest_checkin.review_comment AS latest_review_comment
mapper.select: SELECT FROM learn_task_assignment assignment JOIN learn_task task ON task.id = assignment.task_id LEFT JOIN sys_organization source_organization ON source_organization.id = assignment.source_organization_id JOIN sys_user reviewer ON reviewer.id = assignment.current_reviewer_id LEFT JOIN learn_task_pause active_pause ON active_pause.assignment_id = assignment.id AND active_pause.resumed_at IS NULL AND active_pause.expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP LEFT JOIN learn_task_checkin latest_checkin ON latest_checkin.assignment_id = assignment.id AND latest_checkin.submission_no = ( SELECT MAX(checkin_version.submission_no) FROM learn_task_checkin checkin_version WHERE checkin_version.assignment_id = assignment.id ) WHERE assignment.id = #{id} AND assignment.student_id = #{studentId}
SELECT id, student_id, current_status, current_reviewer_id, version_no FROM learn_task_assignment WHERE id = #{id} AND student_id = #{studentId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE learn_task_assignment SET task_id = #{targetTaskId}, current_status = #{nextStatus}, scheduled_date = #{targetDate}, due_at = #{dueAt}, claimed_at = NULL, completed_at = NULL, last_defer_type = #{deferType}, defer_count = defer_count + 1, overnight_migrated = 1, last_deferred_by_user_id = #{operatorUserId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, last_deferred_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, last_transition_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version_no = version_no + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND current_status = #{expectedStatus} AND version_no = #{expectedVersion}
